Hold [Reload] at full Charged Edge stacks to fire a small <void/>Void Dome.

<void/>Void Dome Properties:
• Lasts 20 seconds with 2400 HP
• 15% added Damage Resistance against Bosses and 85% Damage Resistance against all other Combatants
• Grants a 45 HP <void/>Void Overshield for 10 seconds (15 with <void/>Echo of Persistence) upon entry, with a 1 second cooldown before it can be granted again.
• Grants 'Stat Boost' for 10 seconds, granting ? Reload Speed, ? Handling, and 5% Increased Weapon Damage (which stacks with all other Empowering Sources)
• Benefits from <yellow Helm of Saint-14's /> defensive buffs.
